theme_cn: 疑问词语法 + 听力 + KET词汇 + 写作（机器人模型邀请信） + 键盘拼写
writing_name: 背诵作文 · 邀请朋友来拼机器人

grammar.question: 选词填空（what / where / when / why / how / who / whose）：___ do you go to school every day? By bike.
grammar.explanation_cn: 答句 By bike 说的是方式，问方式用 how。

grammar.question: 选词填空（what / where / when / why / how / who / whose）：___ is your English teacher? Miss Wang.
grammar.explanation_cn: 答句 Miss Wang 是人，问「谁」用 who。

grammar.question: 选词填空（what / where / when / why / how / who / whose）：___ do you like penguins? Because they are cute.
grammar.explanation_cn: 答句以 Because 开头，说明原因，问原因用 why。

grammar.question: 选词填空（what / where / when / why / how / who / whose）：___ schoolbag is this? It is mine.
grammar.explanation_cn: 问「谁的书包」用 whose；who 问人，whose 问「谁的」。

grammar.question: 选词填空（what / where / when / why / how / who / whose）：___ does the museum open? At eight in the morning.
grammar.explanation_cn: 答句 At eight 是时间，问时间用 when。

grammar.question: 选词填空（what / where / when / why / how / who / whose）：___ is the science museum? Near the city park.
grammar.explanation_cn: 答句 Near the park 说的是地点，问地点用 where。

grammar.question: 选词填空（what / where / when / why / how / who / whose）：___ are you doing now? I am drawing a picture of the sea.
grammar.explanation_cn: 答句说正在做的事，问「在做什么」用 what。

listening.question: Listen to the dialogue. What will the two friends do this Saturday?
listening.audio_text: Boy: Hello, Lily! Shall we build my new robot model this Saturday? Girl: Great idea! Can I bring my small tools? Boy: Of course, and Mum will make a birthday cake for us.
listening.explanation_cn: 男孩提议 build my new robot model（拼机器人模型），女孩说 Great idea。

listening.question: Listen to the dialogue. What time should Lily come on Saturday?
listening.audio_text: Girl: Dad, what time shall I go to Tom's home tomorrow? Dad: At nine in the morning, and I will take you there by bike. Girl: OK, I will take my small tools and a ball.
listening.explanation_cn: 爸爸说 At nine in the morning（早上九点），还要骑车送她去。

listening.question: Which picture matches the sentence you hear?
listening.audio_text: It is my birthday today, and Mum made a big cake for me.
listening.explanation_cn: 句子里说 Mum made a big cake（妈妈做了大蛋糕），所以选蛋糕 🎂。

listening.question: Listen and fill in the blank: The robot model is my favourite birthday ___.
listening.audio_text: The robot model is my favourite birthday present.
listening.explanation_cn: 听到 birthday present（生日礼物），所以填 present；这是上周学过的词，复习一遍。

ket_pet.question: KET: My uncle works in a big factory ___ makes delivery robots.
ket_pet.explanation_cn: 先行词 factory 是物，定语从句用 which；who 只能指人。

ket_pet.question: KET: I look forward to ___ from you soon.
ket_pet.explanation_cn: look forward to 里的 to 是介词，后面接动名词 hearing。

ket_pet.question: KET: There ___ a robot show in the museum tonight.
ket_pet.explanation_cn: There will be… 是固定句型；there be 句型不能说 there will have。

ket_pet.question: KET: The bus is coming. Let's ___ the bus quickly.
ket_pet.explanation_cn: 上车是 get on；get up 起床，get off 下车，put on 穿上。

ket_pet.question: KET: Could you tell me ___ to the science museum?
ket_pet.explanation_cn: tell sb. the way to… 告诉某人去某地的路；the way 是固定说法。

writing.title: Dear Amy（四线三格作文 · 全文背默）
writing.requirement_cn: 先把整封信大声读三遍，再把 5 个空填好，最后背诵全文。这封邀请信就是本周要背熟的作文！
writing.template: Dear Amy, Dad bought me a robot {{1}} for my birthday. Can you come to my {{2}} this Saturday? The robot cannot move without a new {{3}}, so we will put it in first. Then we can put all the small parts back into the {{4}} after we finish. Please come at {{5}} o'clock in the morning! Lily
writing.full_text_cn: 亲爱的Amy，爸爸给我买了一个机器人模型作为生日礼物。这个星期六你能来我家吗？机器人没有新电池就动不了，所以我们要先把它装上。拼完以后，我们可以把小零件全部收回箱子里。请早上九点来！莉莉
writing.explanation_cn: 英文邀请信三要素：称呼 Dear Amy 开头、正文说清「请谁、什么时候、来做什么」、结尾用 Please come… 加署名。robot model 机器人模型；without a new battery 没有新电池；put … back into the box 把……放回箱子；at nine o'clock 在九点钟（时刻用 at）。
writing.explanation_en: An invitation note needs a greeting (Dear Amy), the plan (when, where, what to do), and a closing (Please come at nine!) with the name Lily.

spell.question: 模型：m____ [填完整单词]
spell.explanation_cn: robot model 机器人模型；model 也指「榜样」，role model 好榜样。

spell.question: 家：h___ [填完整单词]
spell.explanation_cn: come to my home 来我家；home 也可以说 at home 在家。

spell.question: 电池：b______ [填完整单词]
spell.explanation_cn: bat + tery；机器人没有 battery 就动不了。

spell.question: 箱子；盒子：b__ [填完整单词]
spell.explanation_cn: box 箱子；拼完机器人把零件放回 box 里。
